description: Header file defining the LocationSync plugin class, including nested classes for data handling, notifications, and configuration, as well as interface implementations for plugin, web, and JSON RPC functionalities.

classes.name: LocationSync
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, web, and JSON RPC interfaces, managing location synchronization.

classes.name: Data
classes.description: JSON container class holding location data fields such as IP, timezone, region, country, and city.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Dispatch class handling location change notifications and probing location services.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class for setting update interval, retries, and source URL.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
